title: Persian Literary Optative Mood
summary: Expressing formal wishes, blessings, or curses in classical Persian (باد, مباد).
explanation: Formed historically by adding suffix '-اد' to present stems (e.g. باد = May it be, مباد = May it not be).

example_translations.ex_opt_1: May the name of Iran be eternal forever.

common_error_explanations.err_opt_1: Do not mix archaic optatives with modern subjunctive forms.
